verdict.rationale: The story requires the Secretary of State's own published pages to show the core business filing can be completed online, but nothing on ohiosos.gov or the Ohio Business Central portal was readable (both returned 403 at robots.txt). The probe's description of bsportal as "the filing portal" is the probe's own label, not content from the service's pages. Everything else in the pack comes from separate state surfaces: the Ohio Business Gateway's filing-administrator and OHID sign-in notes, and the Department of Taxation's OH|TAX online tax filing. Those are adjacent or host-platform capabilities and earn no credit toward Secretary of State online business filing.
